name: CAN Bus Message Parser
short_description: Parses CAN bus messages, decodes signals using DBC files, stores decoded data in SQLite, and exposes via a REST API for external tools.
detailed_description: Parses CAN bus messages, decodes signals using DBC files, stores decoded data in SQLite, and exposes via a REST API for external tools.
